items.reason: A vitamin C serum is a fine fit for a brightening goal, and it can stay in your cart.
A tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides helps keep the look of dark patches from deepening in daylight and suits deeper skin tones.
A simple ceramide moisturizer supports your dry-looking, low-moisture skin without adding more actives.

response.routine_note: I haven't added any more brightening products, and please check your hydroquinone cream with your doctor or a dermatologist while you are pregnant, since dark patches in pregnancy are better handled by them than by anything we sell. Use the vitamin C, then moisturizer, then the tinted SPF each morning, and reapply the SPF when you are outdoors.
